We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically to the given molecule (product) reproduces a Diels-Alder reaction (forward). So we need to search template catalog for a Diels-Alder type transformation: bonds formed: C=C to C-C (two new sigma bonds) and bond order changes: two double bonds become single bonds. So functional groups broken: alkenes (C-C double bonds) maybe? functional groups formed: cyclohexene? But the forward reaction forms a six-membered ring from diene and dienophile. In retrosynthesis, we break the cyclohexene into diene and dienophile.

Thus we need to search templates with functional_groups_broken: "C-C double bonds" (since forward reaction forms C-C single bonds, breaking double bonds). functional_groups_formed: maybe "C-C double bonds"? Wait forward reaction forms C-C single bonds, but also forms a new double bond? Diels-Alder product is a cyclohexene (has one double bond). Starting diene has two double bonds, dienophile has one double bond. In forward, two double bonds of diene become single bonds, the double bond of dienophile becomes single bond, and a new double bond forms in the ring (the other double bond of diene remains). So net: bonds broken: two C=C (one from diene, one from dienophile) -> become C-C single bonds. Bonds formed: one new C-C single bond (the other new sigma bond) and one C=C double bond (the remaining double bond). But the template likely captures Diels-Alder as a known reaction.

Simplify: Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with functional_groups_broken: "C-C double bonds", functional_groups_formed: maybe "C-C double bonds"? Not sure.

Let's try search with broken: "C-C double bonds", formed: none. Also bonds_broken: maybe "6-6"? Not.

We'll attempt search with functional_groups_broken: "C-C double bonds".
